answer: Read the referral economy as a graph, not a roster. Honest networks stay sparse: reputation flows through many independent bridges, so no node sits on most paths. A sybil farm must bootstrap density by wiring puppets to each other, forming a dense lobe joined to the real economy by one thin arterial edge. Track betweenness each epoch: a cluster with an outlier internal edge ratio whose entire trust pulse enters through a single cipher-verified gateway is provably one actor in many masks. Referral mass that never escapes its ivory-walled component earns nothing until it funds independent ties.
